title: Atomic-level insights for engineering interfacial hydrogen microenvironments of metal-based catalysts for alkaline hydrogen electrocatalysis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5811-5832
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00943J, Review Article
Kunjie Wang, Xingyu Cui, Jingxuan Zhao, Qing Wang, Xu Zhao
An understanding of the intrinsic relationship between defined atomic properties of metal-based electrocatalysts and interfacial hydrogen microenvironments in alkaline HOR/HER is provided.
